title: Bill 104 kitchenettes for rebuilding homes
summary: As of November 21, 2024, the kitchenette option for additional dwelling units has been removed from Bill 104, which would let owners add two kitchenettes to a main home for extra living space. The fire department warns that more kitchens on a lot can mean more people, vehicles and density, and says it would recommend fire protection measures owners must install if the bill passes. The council sent Bills 103 and 104 to the Housing and Land Use Committee in July.

timeline.text: If the bill passes, the fire department will recommend fire protection measures that owners must install.
The option for kitchenettes in additional dwelling units was removed from the bill.
The fire department said more kitchens on one lot can mean more people, vehicles and density on the same size lot.

Referral of Bill 103 (density in residential districts) and Bill 104 (kitchenettes): The council sent Bills 103 and 104 to the Housing and Land Use Committee.
A testifier said Bill 104 could turn single-family homes into three-family dwellings.
